title: Stagewise auto-apply for Optimize: canary cohorts, gating rules, and human-in-loop approvals
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Implement a stagewise, safety-first auto-apply pipeline for Optimize suggestions (batching/caching/quantization recommendations). The feature should allow suggestions to be applied gradually across customers/routes using canary cohorts and gating rules, surface human approval where risk is high, and provide automatic rollback on observable regressions. This ticket covers server-side controllers, Console flows, metrics/alerting, audit logging, and the safety policy language for gating rules.
acceptance_criteria: Optimize suggestions can be configured to auto-apply in a stagewise rollout (cohorts by customer, route, or percentage)
Canary controller supports configurable metrics gates (latency p50/p95, token cost, error rate, quality eval score) and percent-based progression
Automatic rollback executes when pre-defined thresholds are breached and restores previous config within 60s
High-risk suggestion types (model change, quantization profile, batching strategy that increases latency) require explicit human approval before >10% traffic
Console shows active rollouts, cohort membership, observed metrics vs. gates, and an audit trail of all applied suggestions and rollbacks
API supports creating/updating gated rollout policies and exposes current rollout state for integration tests and webhooks
E2E tests simulate degraded conditions and validate rollback and approval paths
rollout_plan: Phase 1 - Staging: run controller with emulated traffic in staging, validate gate evaluation logic (1 week)
Phase 2 - Canary 1: enable auto-apply for internal customers at 1% of production traffic (48-72h observation)
Phase 3 - Canary 2: expand to 10% if gates pass for 72h, otherwise rollback and open incident
Phase 4 - Gradual ramp: 10% -> 50% -> 100% with manual / automatic progression options
Guardrails: any expansion requires gates to be green for a minimum observation window and no manual objection from on-call or owners
rollback_triggers: p95 latency increase > 20% over baseline (30m rolling)
request error rate increase > 1 percentage point over baseline
quality.eval_regression_score drop > 2% on sentinel prompt set
manual rollback requested by owner or on-call
ui_changes: Console: rollout configuration wizard for Optimize suggestions with cohort selectors and percent sliders
Console: real-time rollout dashboard showing gate pass/fail, trend lines, and one-click rollback/abort
Console: approval queue with reasons, suggested mitigations, and ability to approve/reject with comments
api_changes: GET /optimize/rollouts/:id/state - returns current cohort assignment and gate results
